                          JOINT MOTION TO REMAND PROCEEDING

        Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO) on behalf of all parties1 to this

proceeding, submits this Joint Motion to Remand Proceeding (Motion) and is authorized to state

that all the parties are unopposed. The parties have entered into a Unanimous Stipulation and

Settlement Agreement (Settlement) resolving all issues in this proceeding. The Settlement is being

filed simultaneously with this Motion.

                             I.       Joint Motion to Remand Proceeding

        Included as Attachment B to the Settlement is the parties Proposed Order. SWEPCO

requests that the Administrative Law Judge (ALJ) admit the evidence listed in the Joint Motion to

Admit Evidence filed by the parties on August 13, 2026, and after the admission of evidence,

dismiss the proceeding from the State Office of Administrative Hearings docket and remand it to

the Commission for consideration of the Proposed Order.

                                             II.     Conclusion

        SWEPCO requests the ALJ admit the evidence listed in the Joint Motion to Admit

Evidence, dismiss the proceeding from the SOAH docket, and remand to the Commission for



    1
     The parties are SWEPCO; Staff of the Public Utility Commission of Texas (Commission Staff); Texas Industrial
Energy Consumers; the Office of Public Utility Counsel; Cities Advocating Reasonable Deregulation; and Eastman
Chemical Company.
